resolution: 1:10m source. Land borders shared by two of these countries simplified to 0.001 deg (~110 m), coasts to 0.1 deg (0.5 deg north of 55N in North America). Islands under 0.3 deg dropped within 15 km of a larger piece of the same country and over 50 km from any other. Points on a 1/1000-degree grid, each ring delta-encoded as [dlon, dlat, ...] integers.
source: Natural Earth 1:10m Admin 0 countries (v4.1.0), as packaged by world-atlas@2.0.2 (countries-10m.json, npm registry: `npm pack world-atlas@2`)
use: O195 (D-237): the app's coarse country test for a dropped pin or a garden saved before the address lookup's country was kept (web/src/panels/country.ts). A point in no outline counts as the nearest one within reach_km, else as outside every one. Made by engine/build_country_outline.py.
